capabilities: Send selected Markdown notes to Escreva-me
Limit uploads to the whole vault, chosen folders, or chosen notes
Authenticate with a one-time plugin token from the Escreva-me account
Write exported reflections into the Escreva-me/Reflections/ folder
Remove already-imported notes when a folder is excluded
disambiguation: Not a cross-device vault sync; it only exchanges notes with the Escreva-me service and its Reflections folder.
extras: The README spells out what leaves the vault: note paths and contents of the chosen scope are stored on the user's Escreva-me account, and the plugin token is stored only as a hash; nothing is sent until settings are saved.
problem: Escreva-me users keep their writing in Obsidian but have no built-in way to move those notes into their Escreva-me account or receive reflections back.

relations.evidence: sends the path and contents of the Markdown notes you choose to Escreva-me

summary: Connector that sends selected vault Markdown notes to the Escreva-me service and writes exported daily reflections back into the vault.
